t: Flat, fixed, integrated LED downlight. Power selectable between 4 and 6W. Colour Selectable between 2700, 3000, 4000 and 6000K. Easy installation with ClipFit connector, providing 360° access when wiring cables into terminals. Simply wire direct to removable connector, push fit into ClipFit housing, then lock shut. Features QuickView windows for ease of checking cables are correctly and securely wired to terminals. Supplied with a removable white bezel.
